title: Q3 business review
overview: Leadership reviewed the third quarter. Revenue was 1.9 crore rupees against a target of 2.2 crore. College partners grew from 14 to 21 and paid conversion among students rose from 6.2 to 7.4 percent. Cloud and model costs rose 18 percent to 6.8 lakh rupees a month, but cost per active student fell from 23 to 17 rupees. The team agreed on a Diwali offer of 20 percent off annual plans, approved four engineering hires and one designer for the next quarter, and set a goal to bring monthly cloud spend under 6 lakh.

chapters.title: Revenue and customers
bullets: Revenue was 1.9 crore rupees against a target of 2.2 crore
College partners grew from 14 to 21, and three of the new ones are large
Paid conversion among students rose from 6.2 to 7.4 percent

chapters.title: Cloud and model costs
bullets: Monthly cloud and model cost rose 18 percent to 6.8 lakh rupees
Cost per active student fell from 23 to 17 rupees thanks to prompt changes and a smaller model for easy questions
Goal is to bring monthly spend under 6 lakh by reserving capacity and cleaning unused resources

chapters.title: Diwali offer and pricing
bullets: Offer 20 percent off annual plans during the Diwali week
Campaign goes to existing students first, then to college partner mailing lists
Pooja confirmed the discount keeps the margin positive on an annual plan

chapters.title: Hiring, runway and next steps
bullets: Runway is 17 months, and stays at about 15 months after the planned hiring
Approved four backend engineers and one designer for next quarter
Ankit will visit the two largest college partners before the end of the month

action_items.text: Draft the Diwali offer page and the email to existing students
Share the cloud cost breakdown by service and propose reserved capacity
Update the runway model with the new hiring plan and share it
Confirm the GST and TDS filing dates for the quarter with the accountant
Start the search for four backend engineers and one designer
Visit the two largest college partners in Hyderabad and Pune before the end of the month

segments.speaker: Ankit Khanna
segments.text: Welcome, everyone. This is the quarterly review, so I'd like numbers first and opinions after. Pooja, can you start with revenue?

segments.speaker: Pooja Menon
segments.text: Sure. Revenue for the quarter was one crore ninety lakh. Our target was two crore twenty lakh, so we're about fourteen percent short. Compared with last quarter, it's up twenty-two percent.

segments.speaker: Ankit Khanna
segments.text: Where did we fall short?

segments.speaker: Pooja Menon
segments.text: Mostly timing. Two college partners signed in the last week of the quarter, so their revenue lands in the next one. If I count them, we'd have been within five percent of the target.

segments.speaker: Harshita Rao
segments.text: I can add some detail on that. We went from fourteen college partners to twenty-one. Three of the new ones are large, each with more than two thousand students, and all three go live in the first month of next quarter.

segments.speaker: Ankit Khanna
segments.text: That's encouraging. What about the students who pay directly?

segments.speaker: Harshita Rao
segments.text: Paid conversion went from six point two to seven point four percent. The change that helped most was showing the sample mock interview report before asking for payment. People want to see what they're buying.

segments.speaker: Siddartha Nepal
segments.text: And the placement report we're building this sprint should help that further, because it makes the value visible.

segments.speaker: Ankit Khanna
segments.text: Good. I'd like to see that number above eight percent by the end of next quarter.

segments.speaker: Ankit Khanna
segments.text: Siddartha, costs. I saw a big jump on the invoice.

segments.speaker: Siddartha Nepal
segments.text: Yes. Our monthly cloud and model cost is now six point eight lakh rupees, up eighteen percent. That's mostly because usage grew, we have a lot more students. But I want to be clear that cost per student went down.

segments.speaker: Pooja Menon
segments.text: By how much?

segments.speaker: Siddartha Nepal
segments.text: From twenty-three rupees per active student per month to seventeen. Two things made the difference. We moved the easy questions, like syntax doubts, to a smaller and cheaper model. And Karthik's prompt change reduced the length of what we send each time.

segments.speaker: Ankit Khanna
segments.text: So the unit cost is going the right way, even if the total is not.

segments.speaker: Siddartha Nepal
segments.text: Exactly. And there's more room. About one lakh rupees a month is spent on resources we don't need, old staging environments and snapshots nobody uses. Meera is cleaning those up. And if we reserve capacity for the servers we always run, we save another fifteen to twenty percent.

segments.speaker: Pooja Menon
segments.text: Reserved capacity means we commit for a year, right? I'd want to check that against the runway before we do it.

segments.speaker: Siddartha Nepal
segments.text: Yes, a one year commitment. I'll send you the breakdown by service so you can look at it. My goal is under six lakh a month by the end of next quarter.

segments.speaker: Ankit Khanna
segments.text: Next, the Diwali offer. Harshita, what are you proposing?

segments.speaker: Harshita Rao
segments.text: Twenty percent off the annual plan for the week of Diwali. The annual plan is currently four thousand nine hundred rupees, so it would be three thousand nine hundred and twenty. We'd send it first to our existing students, who've been asking for it, and then to the college mailing lists.

segments.speaker: Pooja Menon
segments.text: I checked the numbers on this. Even at twenty percent off, the annual plan is margin-positive, because the cost per student has come down. At thirty percent it would not be.

segments.speaker: Ankit Khanna
segments.text: Then twenty it is. I don't want a bigger discount that teaches students to wait for sales.

segments.speaker: Harshita Rao
segments.text: Agreed. I'll draft the offer page and the email. And I'd like to keep the monthly price unchanged, so it nudges people towards the annual plan.

segments.speaker: Ankit Khanna
segments.text: Good. Make sure the GST is shown clearly. Last year we had a few complaints about the final amount being different from the price on the page.

segments.speaker: Harshita Rao
segments.text: Yes, I'll show the price with GST included.

segments.speaker: Ankit Khanna
segments.text: Let's talk about hiring and runway. Pooja?

segments.speaker: Pooja Menon
segments.text: Current runway is seventeen months. If we hire four engineers and one designer next quarter, at the salary bands Siddartha shared, it drops to about fifteen months. That's still comfortable, and the revenue growth should extend it again.

segments.speaker: Ankit Khanna
segments.text: I'm comfortable with fifteen. Siddartha, is four the right number?

segments.speaker: Siddartha Nepal
segments.text: Yes. With the college partners coming in, we need more people on ingestion and the reporting side. And one more designer would help Saloni and Dev, they're stretched with the Hindi interface and the new onboarding.

segments.speaker: Ankit Khanna
segments.text: Approved. Siddartha, start the search this week. And Neha is on the offer for the backend engineer we discussed, right?

segments.speaker: Siddartha Nepal
segments.text: Yes, the reference checks are being done. That would be the first of the four.

segments.speaker: Pooja Menon
segments.text: I'll update the runway model with the new plan and send it to everyone. I'll also confirm the GST and TDS filing dates with our accountant, so nothing gets missed during the Diwali week.

segments.speaker: Ankit Khanna
segments.text: Thank you. One last thing from me. I want to personally visit the two largest college partners, in Hyderabad and Pune, before the end of the month. Relationships matter more than any dashboard.

segments.speaker: Harshita Rao
segments.text: I'll send you the contact details and a one page summary for each.

segments.speaker: Ankit Khanna
segments.text: Perfect. Thanks, everyone. A good quarter, even if the number says otherwise.
